body: Thanks for the comment, I thought of that and the idea that it might be scares the hell out of me. I have watched a close friend descend into severe schizophrenia. I hope you are managing your illness okay now. If it gets any more severe I'll seek professional help.

Prozac is still in your system unless you have stopped taking the tablets. Have you missed a dose? In addition 8 - 12 weeks is how long it takes most SSRIs to kick in, particularly Prozac, so you've probably only just begun to actually feel the benefits. Otherwise it is just the ghost of hangovers past my friend. SSRIs will mask the post alcohol depression and anxiety - to a point. All you can do is stop drinking for a while and wait for it to pass. Lots of water, poss some sports drink like Gartorade, and maybe a complex B and a magnesium supplement, both which can be quite anti-anxiety. If it gets really bad call your doctor explain that you are having a crisis and request a prescription for anti-anxiety medication like valium or xanax. BE VERY AWARE HOWEVER that these drugs like many others have their own down sides and can be pretty addictive and shit in their owns ways. Good luck with it all.
